messages:
Ana Rivera: Heads-up — Q4 promo week planning: forecast shows a 2.1x median GPU-hour increase and short spikes up to 3.4x for some routes. Need to lock reservation vs burst strategy by EOD Thurs.
Mike Chen: can you share the regional breakdown? especially us-west vs eu-west.
Ana Rivera: quick numbers from the sim: us-west: 2.6x (peak 3.4x), eu-west: 1.7x, ap-southeast: 1.3x. Most traffic is short-chat + embeddings.
Sara Patel: embeddings are the heavy tail here, right? any changes to batch sizes expected during promos?
Ana Rivera: yep — embeddings spike ~2.8x. Our current batching config auto-batches by 150ms; that helps but doesn't fully cover the tail.
Ben Ortiz: cost ballpark? ops needs a $ estimate for the finance deck.
Ana Rivera: rough calc: baseline 40k GPU-hours/week -> projected 84k GPU-hours/week at peak; using our committed pricing that'd be ~$335k/wk if we had to buy burst cloud hours. If we reserve more Dedicated instances the marginal cost drops ~28%.
capacity-bot: [prediction] Probability of capacity breach (us-west) = 0.22 over promo week based on current autoscale policy and historic traffic. See /link-to-capacity-report
Mike Chen: okay — proposal: reserve an extra 40 gpus in us-west for the week, enable burst pool of 80 gpus shared across regions, and pre-warm caches 12h prior to the promo window. Thoughts?
Sara Patel: +1 on pre-warm. Also request we pin a quantized variant for embeddings to reduce GPU time per call (small perf regression allowed). Need perf tests on that.
Ben Ortiz: finance asks that we show delta vs committed. Can you model committed+burst vs all-on-burst? I can present both.
Ana Rivera: I'll drop the model tonight. Two ask items: (1) ops: update autoscale policy to be more aggressive for embeddings routes; (2) eng-runtime: provide quantized model perf numbers by tomorrow morning.
Robin Lee: @oncall — can we add an alert for sustained 90% GPU util > 10min across >30% of cluster? current alert is 15min. Want faster reaction for promo.
Mike Chen: good call. I'll shorten the alert and add a runbook section for 'promo pre-warm' and 'burst fallback to alt-region'.
Sara Patel: snippets for autoscale I'm proposing (put in PR):
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 6
  max_replicas: 200
  scale_metric: gpu_utilization
  target: 55
  cooldown: 45s
```
Ben Ortiz: also flagging network — egress to our vector DB provider spikes cost, maybe cache embeddings on edge for 24h to reduce egress.
Ana Rivera: good catch. We'll add a short-lived edge cache TTL=24h for frequently seen queries.
capacity-bot: [action] Runbook updated draft: /link-to-draft-runbook (author: Ana Rivera).
deploy-bot: scheduled: pre-warm job starting 2026-11-25T03:00Z (eta 12h) — triggered by Mike Chen.
Mike Chen: action list: Ana model numbers, Sara PR for autoscale, Robin shorten alerts + update runbook, Ben cost delta table. Meeting Friday 10am to sign-off.
Ana Rivera: thanks everyone — if you can't make Friday, drop sign-off in the runbook page. :thumbsup:
Sara Patel: will test quantized embeddings overnight and post perf logs here.
Ben Ortiz: I'll draft the finance slide with two scenarios and include break-even for reserving extra capacity.
Robin Lee: I'll update PagerDuty escalation and shorten alerts; tagging SRE to review.
Ana Rivera: we'll also tag product for any promo window changes. cc @product-team (ping in separate thread).
Mike Chen: closing loop — I'll open PRs for autoscale + runbook edits after Sara confirms perf numbers.
Ana Rivera: great — thanks.
